meta.name: Commander Swipe synergy taxonomy
meta.about: Kinds of card interactions in Magic: The Gathering Commander, as text patterns a recommender can run on Scryfall card data. Themes have enablers (make the resource) and payoffs (reward it); events pair producers with consumers; doublers multiply them. Also typal/card-type/keyword axes, nonbos, bracket flags, deckbuilding role targets, and add/cut/swap scoring settings.
how_to_use: Build one text per card: oracle_text (or each card_faces[].oracle_text joined with a newline), with the card's own name, its short name before the first comma, and 'this creature/artifact/...' replaced by '~'.
Expand the %MACROS% in normalization.macros, then compile each pattern with JavaScript flags 'iu'. %TYPE% and %COLORS% are filled per deck.
A list of patterns matches if any one matches; an {all: [...]} item matches only if every pattern in it matches.
A theme side with only_type_line counts a card only if its type_line contains one of those words; not_type_line skips cards whose type_line contains any of them.
'structured' entries are notes about Scryfall fields (type_line, all_parts, produced_mana), not patterns.
Scryfall queries leave out the base filter; prepend 'f:commander id<=%COLORS% '.
Scoring weights are untested starting guesses; tune them.
sources: Scryfall API and bulk data (card text, oracle tags, game_changer field): https://scryfall.com/docs/api
Commander Spellbook (combos, bracket tags; MIT-licensed backend): https://commanderspellbook.com/
Wizards of the Coast Commander Brackets announcements: https://magic.wizards.com/

steps: text = oracle_text, or join card_faces[*].oracle_text with "\n" when top-level oracle_text is missing
payoff_text = text with parenthesized reminder text removed; keep original text for keyword-action inference

replace self-references with "~": the full card name, the short name before the first comma (e.g. "Drivnod"), and "this (creature|artifact|enchantment|land|planeswalker|saga|vehicle|equipment|aura|spacecraft|permanent|card|spell)"
do NOT lowercase; compile every pattern with the JavaScript flags "i" and "u"
legendary cards: also replace the first word of the name with "~" when it is 4+ letters and not a creature type (e.g. "Kaalia", "Carth", "Acererak"; not "Sliver" in Sliver Legion)

%ENTERS%.pattern: enters?(?: the battlefield)?(?: under your control)?
%ENTERS%.note: matches 2024+ 'enters' wording and older cached text

%TYPE%.note: fill per deck with one creature type and its plural, e.g. (?<!non-)(?:elf|elves)\b; plurals are in typal.plurals when given

%COLORS%.note: commander color identity letters (e.g. rwb); used only inside Scryfall queries

normalization.yaml_quoting: single-quoted strings; backslashes are literal; an apostrophe is written as two ('')
normalization.list_semantics: a list of strings matches if ANY string matches; an item {all: [...]} matches only if EVERY string matches
normalization.keywords_field: names in "keywords" lists are matched exactly (case-insensitive) against Scryfall's keywords[] array
normalization.scryfall_queries: written without the base filter; the app prepends 'f:commander id<=%COLORS% ' to every query
normalization.scryfall_or: lowercase 'or' inside parentheses, e.g. '(kw:cascade or kw:discover)'

inventory.source: Scryfall oracle_cards bulk file, Commander-legal cards only (32643 cards)
inventory.method: payoffs = cards whose text (reminder text and token-making clauses removed, own name as ~) matches a typal payoff template for that type: lords, enters/attacks/dies triggers, counts, cost cuts, tutors, behold, 'another <type>', '<type> spells', '<type>s you control', '<type> cards', 'if you control a <type>', 'sacrifice a <type>', 'tap an untapped <type>'. Ordered by EDHREC rank. support: strong 40+, playable 15-39, thin 5-14, minimal 1-4, none 0.
inventory.generic_payoffs_note: 'Choose a creature type' cards and changelings work for every type; see typal.patterns.generic_payoff and omni_type.

add_score.deck_theme_weights: w_t = (cards matching t)/(nonland size); commander matches x3; floor so any theme the commander names always counts

sub_scores.theme_fit: sum_t w_t * side_match(c,t); side_match favors the side the deck is short on (many enablers, few payoffs -> payoffs score higher)
sub_scores.adjacency_fit: sum over adjacency edges (deck theme -> candidate theme) of edge weight * w_deck_theme * 0.5
sub_scores.combo_fit: max combo_weight over Spellbook variants the candidate completes (respecting bracket preset)
sub_scores.role: sum_r need_r * fills(c,r), need_r = max(0, target_r - have_r)/target_r
sub_scores.curve: + if the candidate MV bucket is under target, - if over
sub_scores.popularity: optional; lift-like ratio or edhrec_rank prior, never raw inclusion %

penalties.price: soft logistic above the user budget cap (Scryfall prices are daily, rough only)

diversity.similarity: Jaccard(theme tags + role tags) + same-MV bonus

add_score.explanations: emit the top 2-3 contributing sub-scores as sentences, e.g. "Payoff for your tokens theme: 14 of your cards make tokens"; "You have 7 ramp cards; template wants 10"; "Completes Sanguine Bond + Exquisite Blood (Mandatory loop; Spellbook: Powerful/3)"
add_score.learning: multiplicative per-deck theme weight update on each swipe, e.g. w_t *= 1.1 on right swipe, 0.95 on left (values are guesses)
add_score.self_test: hide 60% of a known good deck, score, and check how many hidden cards land in the top 10 (thesis benchmark P@10 ~0.58)

factors.low_fit: 1 - synergy score of the card against the rest of the deck (same function as add)
factors.role_surplus: for each role filled: max(0, have_r - target_r)/target_r; 0 if any of its roles is under quota
factors.off_curve: MV bucket over curve target, or MV >= 6 without being a theme payoff or the finisher
factors.dominated: another deck card has the same role set and primary theme tags at strictly lower MV, without an instant-vs-sorcery or flexibility edge (soft signal; text-based "strictly worse" is error-prone)
factors.nonbo: card matches a hoser whose conflicting axis is dense in this deck
factors.bracket_risk: card exceeds the user target bracket (hard flag once a target is set)
factors.low_popularity: optional; low lift/inclusion with the commander, weighted low

protections: cards matching the commander's own enabler/payoff themes at high strength (engine pieces)
pieces of any Spellbook combo fully contained in the deck, or user-marked combo cards
lands while land count <= target; never below a floor of 35 without user override
cards whose removal drops ramp, card-advantage, targeted or mass disruption below target
staple damping: multiply by 0.5 if the card fills an at-or-under-quota role and has a top-ranked edhrec_rank (factor is a guess)
cut_score.standalone_list: top N by cut_score, grouped by role, with how far the deck is over 100 and over each role target

swap_pairing.score: PairScore(Y|X) = CutScore(Y) + alpha*SameRole(X,Y) + beta*SameThemeSlot(X,Y) + gamma*MVCloseness(X,Y) - delta*RoleMinViolatedAfterSwap - inf*Protected(Y)
rules: if X fills an under-quota role, prefer cutting from an over-quota role
adding a land pairs with cutting a land (or a ramp spell if lands are at/over target)
adding a nonland when lands are at target never pairs with a land cut
